literal_meaning: শুকনো খড়ের শব্দানুকরণ; শুকনো খড়ের মতো
figurative_meaning_bn: সহচর শব্দ; অত্যন্ত শুকনো; শুকনো খড়ের মত
figurative_meaning_en: Onomatopoeic word; extremely dry; like dry straw
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাপড়টা খড়খড়ে হয়ে গেছে, পরা যাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: This cloth has become kharkhori dry, can't wear it.
In summer, the soil becomes extremely dry like dry straw.
note: Refers to the rustling sound of dry straw, commonly used in rural Bengali contexts to describe extreme dryness.
